title: Japan raids beer giants over alleged price cartel

blocks.text: TOKYO — Japanese authorities raided four major beer manufacturers Wednesday over suspicions they colluded to hike beverage prices in a violation of anti-monopoly laws, a source familiar with the matter and the firms said. Under investigation are Asahi Breweries, Kirin Brewery, Sapporo Breweries, and Suntory — four giants that reportedly make up around 90 percent of Japan’s beer market share. In a first, the Japan Fair Trade Commission (JFTC) conducted on-site inspections to probe “the allegations regarding a wholesale beer pricing cartel”, the source, requesting anonymity, told AFP.
